title: Many-Body Mobility Edge and Non-Hermitian Skin Effect in an Interacting Quasi-Periodic Spin Chain
summary: Non-Hermitian many-body physics reveals a rich interplay between topology, localization, and boundary effects, yet their collective behavior in interacting disordered systems remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study an interacting non-Hermitian spin chain subject to a quasi-periodic longitudinal field, providing a unified and controlled setting, where non-Hermitian dynamics, interactions, and localization mechanisms intertwine.
